a stiff penalty: People caught driving after drinking alcohol now face a stiff penalty, including a large fine and losing their license.
酒後駕車被抓的人現在會面臨嚴厲的處罰，包括高額罰款和吊銷駕照。
stiff competition: Our school band faced stiff competition at the contest, since twenty strong teams from all over Taiwan took part.
我們學校的樂隊在比賽中面臨激烈的競爭，因為有來自全台各地的二十支強隊參加。
a stiff drink: After hearing the shocking news, my uncle poured himself a stiff drink of whiskey to calm down.
聽到那個驚人的消息後，我叔叔給自己倒了一杯烈威士忌讓自己冷靜下來。
a stiff neck: I slept on the sofa without a pillow last night, and this morning I woke up with a stiff neck.
我昨晚沒用枕頭睡在沙發上，今天早上醒來脖子僵硬。
a stiff upper lip: Even when his business failed, my grandfather kept a stiff upper lip and never complained in front of his children.
即使生意失敗，我祖父仍然保持不露情感的堅忍，從不在孩子面前抱怨。
a stiff breeze: A stiff breeze was blowing across the beach, strong enough to carry away our umbrella and several hats.
一陣強風吹過海灘，強到把我們的陽傘和好幾頂帽子都吹走了。
be bored stiff: If you go to that three-hour speech about tax laws, you will be bored stiff before the first hour ends.
如果你去聽那場三小時關於稅法的演講，不到第一個小時你就會無聊到極點。
scared stiff: When the lights suddenly went out in the haunted house, my little sister was scared stiff and could not move.
鬼屋裡的燈突然熄滅時，我妹妹嚇僵了，一動也不能動。
be stingy with money: My roommate tends to be stingy with money; he never buys snacks to share but always eats ours.
我室友花錢小氣；他從不買零食分享，卻總是吃我們的。
be stingy with praise: Our coach seems to be stingy with praise, so when he says "Good job," we know we really did well.
我們教練似乎不輕易稱讚，所以當他說「做得好」時，我們知道自己真的表現得很好。
a stingy portion: The steak was expensive, but the waiter brought a stingy portion that was smaller than my hand.
那份牛排很貴，但服務生端來的份量小得可憐，比我的手掌還小。
a stormy relationship: The two singers had a stormy relationship, fighting loudly in public and breaking up several times.
那兩位歌手的關係風波不斷，常在公開場合大聲爭吵，還分手了好幾次。
a stormy meeting: It was a stormy meeting; parents shouted at the principal for over an hour about the new school rules.
那是一場激烈爭吵的會議；家長們為了新校規對校長大吼了一個多小時。
stormy weather: Because of stormy weather with heavy rain and strong winds, all ferries to Green Island were cancelled today.
由於狂風暴雨的暴風雨天氣，今天所有開往綠島的渡輪都停駛了。
a stormy debate: The plan to build a new airport led to a stormy debate in the city council, with members shouting at each other.
興建新機場的計畫在市議會引發激烈的辯論，議員們互相大吼。
a straightforward process: Applying for a library card is a straightforward process; you just fill in one form and show your ID.
申請借書證是個簡單明瞭的程序；你只要填一張表格並出示身分證就好。
a straightforward answer: When I asked whether he had broken the vase, he gave me a straightforward answer: "Yes, it was me."
我問他是不是打破了花瓶時，他給了我一個直接坦率的回答：「是的，是我。」
a straightforward person: Linda is a straightforward person who always tells you exactly what she thinks, even if it hurts a little.
琳達是個直率的人，總是直接告訴你她的想法，即使有點傷人。
fairly straightforward: The instructions for the new printer were fairly straightforward, so I set it up in less than ten minutes.
新印表機的說明相當簡單，所以我不到十分鐘就把它裝好了。
strategic planning: Good strategic planning helped the small company decide which markets to enter over the next five years.
良好的策略規劃幫助這家小公司決定未來五年要進入哪些市場。
a strategic location: Because the island sits at a strategic location between two major sea routes, many countries want to control it.
由於這座島嶼位於兩條主要航道之間的戰略位置，許多國家都想控制它。
strategic thinking: Chess players need strategic thinking, planning several moves ahead instead of only reacting to the other player.
西洋棋選手需要策略性思考，提前規劃好幾步，而不只是對對手做出反應。
a strategic partnership: The two airlines formed a strategic partnership so that passengers can easily book connecting flights on either company.
這兩家航空公司建立了策略夥伴關係，讓乘客可以輕鬆預訂任一家公司的轉機航班。
a strategic decision: Closing the small stores and selling only online was a strategic decision to cut costs and reach younger shoppers.
關閉小門市、只在網路上販售，是為了降低成本並接觸年輕顧客的策略性決定。
a striking resemblance: Lucy bears a striking resemblance to her aunt, so strangers often think they are mother and daughter.
露西和她阿姨驚人地相似，所以陌生人常以為她們是母女。
a striking contrast: The modern glass tower stands in a striking contrast to the old temple right next to it.
那棟現代玻璃大樓和它旁邊的老廟形成了鮮明的對比。
a striking example: This old village, now full of cafés and visitors, is a striking example of how tourism can change a quiet place.
這個如今滿是咖啡館與遊客的老村莊，是觀光如何改變一個寧靜地方的顯著例子。
striking features: The actress is famous for her striking features, especially her large green eyes and bright red hair.
那位女演員以突出的特徵聞名，尤其是她的大綠眼睛和鮮紅色頭髮。
within striking distance: With only two points between them and first place, our team is within striking distance of the championship.
我們隊和第一名只差兩分，冠軍已近在咫尺。
striking workers: The striking workers stood outside the factory with signs, refusing to return until they received higher pay.
罷工工人舉著標語站在工廠外面，拒絕在加薪之前回去上班。
